register.reg_long_name: System Performance Monitors Event Filter Control Register
register.reg_condition: when FEAT_SPMU is implemented and FEAT_AA64 is implemented

purpose_text.para: With SPMEVTYPER<n>_EL0 and SPMEVFILT2R<n>_EL0, configures when event counter SPMEVCNTR<n>_EL0 in System PMU <s> increments.
The contents of this register are IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED. For more information, see SPMEVTYPER<n>_EL0.

access_permission_text.para: To access SPMEVFILTR<n>_EL0 for System PMU <s>, set SPMSELR_EL0.SYSPMUSEL to s and SPMSELR_EL0.BANK to n[5:4].
SPMEVFILTR<n>_EL0 reads-as-zero and ignores writes if any of the following are true:

listitem.content: Event counter <n> is not implemented by System PMU <s>.
